group.title: An accessible entrance
group.passage:
M1: We have twenty applicants coming for interviews on Thursday. Could you confirm that the side entrance will be available? One applicant has asked about step-free access.
F1: The entrance itself is open, but painters have left equipment in the corridor. I'll ask them to clear it this afternoon.
M1: Thank you. The invitation currently directs everyone through the front doors, which have three steps.
F1: We should include a simple map showing the side entrance. That would help delivery drivers too, since the street signs are small.
M1: I'll update the interview email, but I don't have a suitable map.
F1: Facilities made one last month. I'll send you the file after I speak with the painters.
group.passageZh:
男：星期四有二十位應徵者來面試。請確認側門能使用好嗎？一位應徵者詢問免走階梯的通道。
女：入口是開放的，但油漆工在走廊放了設備。我今天下午請他們移開。
男：謝謝。目前邀請函引導大家走有三階階梯的正門。
女：應附上標示側門的簡單地圖。街道路牌很小，這也能幫到送貨司機。
男：我會更新面試信，但沒有合適的地圖。
女：設施管理部上個月做了一份。我跟油漆工談完就寄給你。
